capabilities: Reorder files with per-folder drag-and-drop sorting
Focus the file tree on a single folder and its descendants
Show per-folder file counts and color folder icons
Find and delete empty notes, unreferenced attachments, and empty folders
Pin notes and folders to a dedicated pinned view
disambiguation: Not a standalone file browser; it modifies Obsidian's built-in file explorer in place.
extras: Interface is bilingual (English and Chinese) and follows the Obsidian language setting; the README states the plugin makes no network requests and collects no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Aio Explorer is a derivative work built on top of several open-source Obsidian plugins and a theme.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers only basic sorting and no per-folder ordering, pinning, focus filtering, or cleanup, which previously required installing several separate plugins.
